    Loops in Galois covers #

    Walks of P act on pairs (h, γ) (a sheet h and a walk class γ of the Galois cover from a base point to (x, h)) by lifting each arrow (liftFG). Paths of P with the same nonzero value lift to paths of the cover with the same nonzero value, so the action factors through the fundamental groupoid of P (gAct). Consequently a nonzero endomorphism of the cover whose image in P has trivial homotopy class has trivial class itself (cls_eq_id_of_proj).
